scheme_name: The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Applicant must belong to the Khasi‑Jaintia or Garo community or as decided by the state government
Applicant must have secured at least 60% aggregate marks in the preceding examination
The course of study must be a regular course, not technical or vocational
The course must be pursued at a recognized institution in India
Applicant must not be employed in any capacity under the Government
benefits_summary: Provides a book grant ranging from ₹500 to ₹1500 per student per academic course, varying by level and stream.
